The '''Merisee Asylum''' adjoined the [[Merisee Grand Medical Facility]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Caronath]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. It contained those afflicted with mental illnesses.
